lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba2Mg12Si2 (reduced formula BaMg6Si) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Ba, Mg, and Si centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Ba and Si environments involve 8 Mg and 4 of the other element, while Mg environments are predominantly Mg with variable Ba or Si mixing. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
